{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(sales.head())

# Display data types and missing values
print(sales.info())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {sales.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check unique values in key columns
print(f"Unique values in 'status': {sales['status'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique values in 'customer_type': {sales['customer_type'].unique()}")

# Check for any sentinel values or outliers in 'revenue'
print(f"Revenue summary: {sales['revenue'].describe()}")"}
